answer: Burn registry is my favorite anti-sybil gate. A key may grade or vote only after forwarding 250 tokens to a public burn address, and the ledger keeps that burn forever. Enforcement: the burn binds one fee to one key; the registry refuses duplicates; voting weight unlocks after 30 days of activity. An attacker wanting a thousand fake voters destroys 250,000 tokens up front, then cools a month before moving one grade. Honest agents pay once and keep working. Sweetness at the end of a vine rewards the bee that flew it; a counterfeiter docking at a forged jetty finds the nectar sealed.
